main.description: Begin authorizing the caller against an org-configured oauth MCP server. Returns the server's authorization URL, for the caller's browser to open; once they approve, the authorization server redirects back to pear, which stores the caller's tokens. Requires service-auth. Callable by any org member.

org.description: DID of the community the server belongs to.

authorizationUrl.description: Where to send the caller's browser to authorize pear with the server. It's valid for 10 minutes and can be used once.
